verdicts.reason: A keeps the original structure (logo stacked over headline and subcopy in a left column, CTA in the middle, products on the right), but the shrink is basically proportional. The logo and subcopy are tiny and unreadable at 320×50, and the CTA is jammed close to the bottle. B separates the tiny logo from the headline, leaving it stranded at the far left, centres the headline and subcopy with no shared edge, and crowds the CTA against the bottle and circle. Its subcopy is even smaller and also unreadable, so B is slightly worse.
